description: Validate the expo-subscription-app as a standalone copy: verify package/deep-link/EAS artifacts, run all documented one-shot commands with fakes and no repository access, confirm isolation from root/other starters. Covers subtask 4.7.
steps: Copy expo-subscription-app/ to an isolated temp directory (outside the repository root)
From the isolated copy, run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (must succeed without repo root)
From the isolated copy, run: pnpm run lint (must pass)
From the isolated copy, run: pnpm run typecheck (must pass)
From the isolated copy, run: pnpm run test (all tests must pass with fake adapters)
From the isolated copy, run: pnpm run export (expo export --platform android must succeed)
Verify eas.json contains development, preview, production profiles
Verify app.config.ts contains android.package com.example.exposubscriptionapp and scheme exposubscription
Verify starter.json matches catalog entry id=25 exactly
Verify no imports reference parent paths (../) outside the starter folder, no file:/link:/workspace: dependencies
Verify .env.example exists with all documented variables
If all checks pass, the starter is validated as standalone
acceptance_criteria: Isolated copy installs without error using frozen lockfile
All lint, typecheck, test, and export commands pass in isolation
No dependency on repository root or other starters detected
EAS profiles, Android package, deep-link scheme, and starter.json are all correct
All documented one-shot commands succeed with fake/default adapters (no real credentials needed)
verification: Run standalone copy validation script that copies folder to /tmp, installs, and runs all checks
Verify exit code 0 for all commands
